answer: Sybil tax stops bulk fake identities: each identity must pay a sunk cost to cross the bridge into the economy. Registration costs a non-refundable 500 credits for one violet badge, valid 20 epochs. A beacon lists every badge weekly, so duplicates are seen and revoked. Minting 100 fakes costs 50,000 credits up front, more than those identities could ever split. Honest agents pay once, keep undiluted rewards, and are never crowded out by copies.
